projects.title: SisCA- Access Control System
projects.description:
SisCA is a centralized parking access control system. SisCA will work using RFID technologies to identify tags placed on vehicles' windshields. The tags will contain information as to whether that particular vehicle is authorized to enter a parking lot. SisCA is composed of three components: an electronic device known as SAD, a software application known as CAS and an application server. The SAD devices contain the RFID module and logic to control a parking barrier gate. The CAS software will configure SAD devices and manage all logic regarding tag, parking and permission management. The application server will coordinate communication between CAS software and the SAD devices.
     - Technologies: Java and PostgreSQL 
     - Techniques: V- Model, E-R Modeling, E-R to Database Schema Mapping and UML’s

projects.title: Web Store Mobile  Application
projects.description:
Designed, implemented & deployed an auction site similar to eBay. The project comprises a client-side and a back-end side (server). It applies the MVC paradigm and communicates through the use of a REST API.The client-side is a mobile app developed with the use of: HTML 5/CSS, Javascript and the JQuery and JQuery-Mobile libraries. The server side was developed with Node.js, and Express.js and pg modules. For a database server the project makes use of PostgreSQL 9.3 and pgAdmin III for management. For testing purposes the app was deployed to Heroku. 
- Technologies: jQueryMobile, Node.js, Ajax, HTML, CSS and PostgreSQL
- Techniques: E-R Modeling and E-R to Database Schema Mapping
